description:
As part of its ongoing commitment to community welfare, Prabhat Roadways contributed ₹5,000 towards the monthly food and medical expenses of the residents of Shivrun Old Age Home.

The contribution supports the nutritional needs and essential medical care of 35 senior citizens, helping ensure their well-being, health and dignity.

A small step towards a healthier and happier life! ❤️
